inputs.modified_text: Tom Homan isn’t ruling out immigration enforcement at polling places, and he’s right to ask what Democrats are afraid of. A lawful election should have nothing to hide from ordinary enforcement of the law. The administration’s mixed answers have created needless confusion, but protecting the integrity of the vote and upholding the rule of law should not be treated as partisan offenses.
